name: John Curtis
stance: Backs targeted, commonsense AI safeguards — whistleblower protection, content transparency, and congressional hearings — while preserving U.S. AI leadership and avoiding a new regulator.

statements.text: Introduced the bipartisan AI Labeling Act with Sens. Schatz and Warner to require transparency for AI-generated content.
With Sen. Blunt Rochester, called for swift congressional hearings and regulation on AI.

They should be able to report serious legal, security, or public safety concerns without risking their careers or being silenced by an NDA. This bill provides that protection without creating another federal regulator or standing in the way of responsible innovation.

review.note: added October 2026 from curtis.senate.gov primary sources; quote verified verbatim
